features.name: cache-tier pricing (Claude) — input is three prices, not one
features.note: 8b12a93. Anthropic bills input at 1x fresh / 1.25x 5m cache write / 2x 1h cache write / 0.1x cache read. Priced against a real Claude Code session: $15.22 true vs $112.85 at the flat rate (7.4x). 13 Claude entries now verified:true from Anthropic's pricing page; OpenAI entries stay false and say so. 15 tests.

features.name: Claude Code skill: MCP + automatic session reporting
features.note: 8b12a93 (BUILD-6). integrations/claude-code/: report-session.py parses the transcript (deduped by message id — 317 records for 181 messages in one real session, so summing would overstate ~75%), install.py merges MCP + a Stop hook into Claude Code settings without rewriting them. 17 reporter tests + 10 installer tests.

features.name: SDK wrappers: one line to the proxy (agentledger.wrap)
features.note: BUILD-3 (06faf27). Repoints an existing OpenAI/Anthropic SDK client at the proxy without patching or subclassing it; the provider credential is untouched. Tested against the REAL installed SDKs - which is how the httpx-vs-httpx2 URL-type incompatibility was found. 8 tests.

features.name: CLI init + share + client packaging
features.note: BUILD-5 (06faf27). `agent-ledger init` mints a workspace, claims an agent, writes a working .env; `share` prints a browser-openable link. pyproject ships the CLIENT only (agentledger + cli); the engine stays server-side. NOT published to PyPI - installs from the repo or git.

features.name: provider coverage: any vendor, config not code (DeepSeek)
features.note: fd5cb57. providers.json makes the proxy forward to any OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible vendor; pricing is keyed by MODEL so a caller cannot route around its price by switching endpoints; cache-hit input is priced at the cache rate (DeepSeek hit rate ~50x cheaper). Live: /v1/pricing shows 11 models incl. deepseek-v4-flash with cache_hit; the 404 lists a config-only provider (moonshot) proving nothing in the code knows it. Prices marked verified:false - read from a docs page, not confirmed by an operator.

features.name: token-to-cost auto-pricing on /v1/track
features.note: BUILD-4 (7dbc18d). amount_cents optional: tokens+model are priced from the shared table; an unpriced model is refused (422 model_not_priced) rather than recorded as free. Live-verified fail-closed paths; happy path covered by 9 tests.
